sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 2928.1 ± 717.2 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by anti-FLAG-FITC antibody staining of intact (non-permeabilized) Hi5 cells; receptor reached the plasma membrane. No explicit ligand-binding or G-protein coupling assay reported specifically for the N-terminal-tagged construct.
sites.rationale: HTR5A has no signal peptide; the computed topology places residues 1–39 extracellular, making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus of this GPCR. L1 reports multiple N-terminal tags on the full-length, membrane-anchored receptor; L2 explicitly confirms surface display via non-permeabilized anti-FLAG-FITC labeling, establishing insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before M1) by topology derivation. L3 independently corroborates BRIL at the same N-terminal position. The 39-residue extracellular N-terminal stretch provides ample buffer (>3 residues) from TM1 boundary at residue 40. Full-length human 5-HT5A cloned into pFastBac with N-terminal HA, FLAG, 15×His, and BRIL tags; expressed in Hi5 insect cells; surface display confirmed by anti-FLAG-FITC labeling of non-permeabilized cells at 4°C (L2). Construct used for cryo-EM structural studies (L1, L3).

sources.claim: The human full-length 5-HT 5A was cloned into the pFastBac with an N-terminal haemagglutinin (HA) sequence followed by a Flag-tag, 15× His-tag, BRIL-tag, and a LgBiT sequence at the C-terminus to facilitate the protein expression and purification.

literature_notes: L2 and L3 both ground the same N-terminal prepend site as L1 and are treated as corroborating evidence rather than separate sites. L4 (LgBiT at C-terminus) is intracellular and placed in other_positions. No ledger line supports any internal extracellular loop insertion for HTR5A.

literature_other_positions.note: LgBiT fused at the C-terminus via a 15-aa flexible linker for NanoBiT G-protein coupling assays; the C-terminus (residues 342–357) is intracellular per computed topology, so this is not a surface tag site.
